_about: Arm paths copied from Higgsfield reference videos by MediaPipe (tools/motionref/ref_paths.py). Per clip: fps, n frames, L/R wrist and Le/Re elbow from the shoulder in arm lengths (x his left, y up, z front, flattened xyz), lean = [pitch, roll] per frame.

talk-hands.what: answers a question at the press table, talking with his hands

trophy-lift.what: looks at the cup at his chest, lifts it overhead, shakes it

roar.what: on his knees: arms wide, fists in for the roar, arms up

wave-clap.what: walks through the guard of honour, waves up, claps over his head

shirt-up.what: holds the new shirt up for the cameras
